info.text: The project goal is to design a new remote control that is original, trendy, and user-friendly.
The team consists of Adam Dugard, Ebenezer (marketing expert), and Dave Cochran (user interface designer).
The agenda for the meeting includes tool training, project plan discussion, and closing.
The design process will involve three phases: functional, conceptual, and detailed design.
The target price range for the remote control is 2.5 Euros per unit, with a goal of selling for 25 Euros.
The team aims to make a profit of 50 million Euros.
Ideas for the new remote control include a touch screen LCD, programmable macros, and control of multiple units.
The remote control should be small, stylish, and have a unique feature, such as a joystick or d-pad.
The team needs to decide on the basic functionality and user interface of the remote control.

summary: The project goal is to design a new remote control that is original, trendy, and user-friendly. The team, consisting of Adam Dugard, Ebenezer, a marketing expert, and Dave Cochran, a user interface designer, will undergo tool training and discuss the project plan. The design process involves three phases: functional, conceptual, and detailed design. The target price range is 2.5 Euros per unit, with a goal of selling for 25 Euros and making a profit of 50 million Euros. The remote control should be small, stylish, and have a unique feature. The team needs to decide on the basic functionality and user interface, which may include a touch screen LCD, programmable macros, and control of multiple units.
